pages.title: The Common Table
pages.text: Link physical storage to your town and enable it as a resident food source.

pages.title: The Common Table
pages.text: Salads immediately stock the authorized food supply for the resident-feeding lesson.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: In your town screen, link an accessible chest or supported physical storage and enable feeding. Foreign storage cannot be claimed; a virtual terminal alone does not prove physical access.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Storage linking and feeding permission are separate native settings; a terminal does not promise access to its entire network.
